hypothesis: The unchanged 474-parameter encoder can learn direct/inverse lexical meaning from observed consequences, preserve acquired SVO/OSV bindings and transfer unchanged from NAND to NOR. An additional held-out word-by-layout slice tests whether lexical meaning composes with word order rather than merely fitting seen word/order pairs.

data_contract.training: 384 fresh single-contact NAND outcomes plus exactly the original 384 bilingual-v1 TRAIN outcomes: 640 episodes / 768 forecasts. Uniform mean per observed outcome gives equal fresh/rehearsal weight. Fresh effects are balanced192:192; all-direct rehearsal makes total exposure576direct:192inverse (3:1), intentionally retention-weighted. No old or fresh challenge outcome enters fitting.
data_contract.new_examples: 256 balanced original-layout single-contact examples, plus 128 examples teaching synonym-index-zero words in the other layout. All give only words, observed native context and later world readings to the candidate.
data_contract.lexicon: Controlled direct contacts/touches and dax/mip versus inverse receives/accepts and vok/nuz. Inverse selects the opposite already acquired ordered contact while preserving mention positions. These are controlled usages, not a claim about unrestricted English.
data_contract.structural_holdout: contacts/receives and dax/vok (synonym index 0) appear in both layouts during fitting; touches/accepts and mip/nuz (index 1) appear only in their original layout. At evaluation, replace only the final word with its other-lexicon same-meaning counterpart, preserving layout/history. Report seen-layout and held-out word-by-layout cases separately, using contrast_synonym for the actual final word rather than the trajectory's starting synonym variant.
data_contract.challenge: Per law: 1152 episodes / 4160 forecasts, 576 final lexical pairs. Fresh names/permutations and 3-5 contact chain/fork/cycle/repeated/disjoint families. Prefixes alternate meanings; paired final probes share the full prefix and differ only in one lexical token, with distinct complete-world truths.
data_contract.retention: Updated encoder alone forecasts the original 2080-point bilingual challenge per law/seed and is compared against archived grounded outputs. This opened-bank regression measurement is separate from new generalization evidence; original models, traces and decisions are not rerun or replaced.
data_contract.identity_and_context: Supplied exact roster equality, three-token event boundaries, two candidate ordered contacts, full noiseless endpoint feedback and observed native acquisition/reset actions with ordered operands. Linguistic events receive no gold participant-order or action-kind labels, hidden-mode label, language ID or parser program. Native calibration actions remain observed context.
data_contract.dependency: Languages, synonyms, lexical branches, role reversals, modes, laws and seeds are matched dependent views, not independent physical trials. Same-team public generation; no independent challenge custody.

model.implementation: Reuse bilingual_model.OrderEncoder, tokenization, two-order mixture, native world and outcome objective byte-for-byte. No new model parameters, action kinds, physics, feature dimensions or workspace.
model.initialization: Each candidate starts from the successful grounded bilingual-v1 checkpoint of the same seed. Fresh Adam state; no optimizer-resume claim. Only observed outcome NLL updates language weights; no teacher logits, old predictions, parser labels or gold order supervise fitting.
model.prior: The unchanged parent grounded encoder forecasts the fresh canonical lexical bank once. Its old-bank predictions are read from archived traces, not recomputed.
model.masked: Evaluation-only final-probe control: zero only the current nonidentity token's character feature coordinates. Reuse the updated encoder's unchanged actual prefix state and native likelihoods. Matched lexical twins now have identical effective inputs.
model.swapped: Evaluation-only final-probe control: exchange direct/inverse current words, preserving names, positions and actual prefix. Compare its distribution and prediction with the counterpart's canonical forecast and truth, not only with the original truth.
model.cross_order: Evaluation-only final-probe transfer view: replace current word by its same-meaning counterpart from the other controlled lexicon. Keep the entire original prefix and current name layout. This is a valid new combination, not a wrong-message ablation.
model.comparison_scope: Five candidate fits only. Current-query interventions and the old encoder isolate the new question; the earlier parser/text-only/direct-sequence comparisons remain historical evidence and are not refitted. No architecture-superiority claim.

fit.optimizer: Fresh Adam defaults; full-data mean observed complete-world NLL; final prescribed update, no early stopping or checkpoint selection
fit.selection: One prescribed attempt. No hyperparameter search, challenge tuning, retries or old-challenge rehearsal. Retain every failure.

analysis.primary: Each law/seed: full canonical family/language world and order accuracy >=95%, mean NLL<=0.05 and reversed-role whole-trajectory conjunction>=95%; final-probe world/order accuracy and NLL also pass separately by family/language/lexical polarity. Both-twin lexical conjunction >=95% each family/language, minimum lexical probability gap>=0.8, all critical true-world probabilities>=0.9 and opposite-world probabilities<=0.1. Preserve bilingual/synonym consistency and zero native-correct to candidate-wrong outcomes.
analysis.controls: Masked twin distributions match within TV1e-10 and masked both-correct pair count is zero (balanced MAP<=50%). Swapped probe distributions match counterpart canonical probes within TV1e-10 and put >=0.9 on counterpart truth. Updated probe accuracy exceeds parent by >=0.25 per law/seed. All views are collected before oracle scoring.
analysis.retention: Zero archived-parent-correct to updated-wrong complete worlds; report every repair, regression and NLL increase/decrease without averaging away failures. Retain old family/language, whole-trajectory and role-pair accounting. Rehearsal is disclosed as old TRAIN evidence only.
analysis.structural_transfer: Separately apply >=95% world/order accuracy per family/language/polarity, NLL<=0.05, true probability>=0.9, foil probability<=0.1, lexical probability gap>=0.8 and both-twin conjunction>=95% to synonym1 borrowed-word probes. The synonym0 seen-combination control must meet the same criteria; report both strata separately. This diagnostic does not retroactively change the primary lexical KEEP decision or imply full G3 completion.
analysis.denominator: Across two laws and five seeds: 41600 canonical candidate +41600 parent +11520 masked +11520 swapped +11520 cross-order +20800 opened-bank candidate retention =138560 collected forecast rows, plus41600 separately labeled evaluator-only fresh native references. Sixty traces. Missing/invalid inventory yields STOP.

limits: Only two supplied directed contact alternatives; no newly invented operator or action-kind
Exact identity linkage and candidate structure remain supplied
No general-language, clarification, communication-policy or architecture-superiority claim
Opened-bank retention is not new generalization evidence
Report actual added and retained code size; overall inclusive2000-line objective remains unmet
